data: Is the solid green line in the middle right plot consistently above the solid red line?

The solid green line is consistently above the solid red line across all three subplots. The green line represents the identification accuracy of character frequency features for a different training and test Tweets, while the red line represents the same for another set of Tweets. The green line is always positioned higher than the red line on the y-axis, indicating better performance.
